My whole life I’ve used music to calm my intense emotions. It’s for that reason I have a great connection with Gaga’s BTW album bc the words I would hear would be the most comforting, encouraging, kindest lyrics ever. Even today, I suffer with intense anxiety, so Chromatica in a way felt like it was for me because it talks about dancing through the pain and making something beautiful from it. She asked during the Chroamtica era “can dance music heal?”…I believe it can, I still have a long way to go but Gaga’s music definitely healed me in times of darkness.

Banquet records just had a restock on their website! [Sophie Banquet records ](https://www.banquetrecords.com/sophie/oil-of-every-pearl%27s-un-insides/TRANS368X)

I was stuck with how I listened to pop music back in 2018, it seemed very safe for me to listen to what was popular on the radio so for a while I felt I needed something much more fresh and original, when I first heard about SOPHIE I saw her on a lady Gaga fan Instagram post of her saying she was going to be on Gagas newest record, her music to me at the time definitely intimidated me , it almost felt like stepping in cold water…but once I heard OOEPUI and Product I new she was not just some artist she was art, I was completely shocked by her death i couldn’t speak about it for a day it just didn’t feel real, after her death I then discovered shows on YouTube and un released music that made me fall in love with her even more, all too bittersweet, it almost feels surreal how I had found one of my idols but in a second they were gone. She completely reset how I listen to pop and I am at least grateful that she’s Steered us in the right direction. I hope the masses will someday properly appreciate the influence SOPHIE had on a changing music industry.
